method.name: Integrated ownership
method.description: How much of the company each party holds, directly and through the companies it holds: shares are multiplied along each path and added across paths, and a company's own shares are given back to its other holders. Each source is computed on its own; figures from two sources are listed side by side, never added. Shareholdings only — voting rights, roles and control are not shares. For a person it is arithmetic on what was filed, not a determination of beneficial ownership. Context, not a finding.
method.credit: Method: integrated ownership as published by T-Rank (https://docs.trank.no/white_papers).

response.note: Calculated figures are arithmetic on what the sources filed — shares multiplied along each path and added across paths, one figure per source, never added across sources — not a determination that anyone is a beneficial owner. Declared beneficial owners are as each register publishes them.

response.hint: Context, not a risk finding. 'may_be_above' means the figure could meet the threshold (a band that straddles it, or a path whose share is not stated); read it as unknown, never as above. Two figures for one party are two sources' readings: never add them. Call opencheck_ownership_map to see the structure, or opencheck_lookup for risk signals.
